title: Book Two · Chapter 172: The Amount Dad Returns
story:
Dad comes home late on Saturday. A small paper bag hangs from his wrist. He puts it on the kitchen table and sits down before he opens it.

“Long day?” Mum asks.

“A job came back. I needed to check it again.”

“Food first,” she says.

Ronan moves a chair away from the table. Dad has a red mark on one hand. It is only a scrape, but he washes it and dries it carefully.

The paper bag holds bread and a small work slip. Dad takes the slip out before the food. Dad crossed out one number. He wrote a smaller number below it.

“Is that the job from last week?” Ronan asks.

Dad nods. “I returned part of the payment today.”

“You worked on it twice.”

“The second visit was for a mistake in the first job.”

He puts the slip in his pocket. Mum gives him a bowl of hot food. For a few minutes, only the spoons make a sound.

Ronan looks at Dad's tired face.

“Do you feel good now?” he asks.

Dad looks up. “About what?”

“Giving the money back.”

Dad thinks for a moment. “I would like to keep the money. I am tired. But I am glad I gave back the extra money.”

“All of those?”

“All of those.”

Mum pushes the bread toward him. “And hungry.”

“Very hungry.”

Ronan smiles, but it does not stay. He touches the edge of his own bowl.

“My practice record has an extra independent mark,” he says.

Both parents look at him. He explains the fourth page and the total. He tells them that he found the mistake on Monday. He also tells them about the final choice next week.

Dad lets him finish the story. Mum asks one question about the rule. Ronan answers it with the same words from the notice.

“Three means I cannot go,” he says.

“Yes,” Mum says quietly.

“I hate that.”

“I can see that.”

No one calls him a good boy. Dad finishes his food and gets another cup of water. Mum sits with Ronan while he talks through the task again.

Later, Dad asks if he wants a walk to the corner. They go together. They talk about Dad's scrape, the bread, and a loose stone near the green door.

At home, Ronan takes out the unfinished note. This time, he writes the whole sentence. Leo helped me find the line in the fourth task. He opens the fourth page to show the HELP box. Then he puts the note on top of the page.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

payment＝支付的钱；scrape＝擦伤；extra＝多出的；return＝退还。

## 理解问题

1. Dad对退还一部分工钱同时有什么真实感受？
2. Ronan这次向父母说清了哪些此前没有说清的事？

## 读句子

**This time, he writes the whole sentence.**

拆开看：This time, / he / writes the whole sentence.

这一次／他／写下了完整的句子。
